site.name: Dozer Mine
overview: Dozer Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine in Boulder County's tungsten district, preserved in federal mineral records as a past-producing underground property.

timeline.text: Federal mineral-exploration records preserved a substantial Defense Minerals Exploration Administration file for the Dozer tungsten property.

moreHistory: Federal mineral records place the Dozer Mine at approximately 39.9819, -105.4983 and classify it as a past-producing underground tungsten mine. Detailed production totals and a fuller operating chronology have not been confirmed in the retained sources.

sourceReferences.title: USGS Data Series 1004 — Historical Files from Federal Government Mineral Exploration-Assistance Programs, 1950 to 1974
